stdout_json.example:
# App settings
APP_NAME=<string>
export PORT=<number>
DEBUG=<boolean>

DATABASE_URL="<secret>"
API_KEY='<secret>'
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=<secret>
HOME_URL=<url> # public site
ADMIN_EMAIL=<email>
CACHE_DIR=<path>
GREETING="<string>"
# OLD_TOKEN=<secret>
REDIS=<interpolated>
PORT=<number>
EMPTY=
# (line 18 removed: not a KEY=value assignment)

name: AWS documentation's example key id AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE is recognised by shape

flags: value looks like an AWS access key id

name: blank mode keeps quotes and export, empties values
secret-looking key with a value is flagged; an empty one is not
unterminated quote swallows the rest and says so

flags: unterminated quote: the rest of the file was read as its value
